sections.title: Theory, Composition & Musicianship II
sections.description: Continuation of techniques established in Theory and Musicianship I. Explores chromatic harmony and extended tonality. Concepts will be developed through analysis and model composition (song form, prelude, large ternary form). Repertoires are drawn from Western classical music and popular and jazz forms. Musicianship component will include sight singing, clef reading, harmonic dictation and keyboard harmony.
